name: addressing the rumors...
source:
Hi guys. Sorry for all of this secrecy. I couldn't speak about it all sooner. I hope you can forgive me for all that silence. In today's video, I'll be addressing the rumors that started going around. You guys just deserve to know the truth.

[From [url=https://ednaarel.itch.io/addressing-the-rumors]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
嗨，大家好。對不起，一直瞞著大家。之前有些事我實在沒辦法開口。希望你們能原諒我沉默了那麼久。今天這支影片，我想回應一下最近傳開的那些流言。你們有權知道真相。
